title: placement.create, contract version 1
description: Places an entry below a node of a site (PRD 5.7): the placement's id, which the caller makes, the entry, the node, the site the node belongs to, and a slug in each locale the placement is to have, each a locale the site publishes in. The placement is hidden until its window is set with placement.set_window. A slug another placement has below the node in the locale is placement_slug_taken, and a create of an id that exists is version_conflict. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Placements\Domain\Commands\CreatePlacement, and the generated codec CreatePlacementCodecV1 reads it and writes its canonical JSON: every key, sorted, no whitespace.

entry.description: The id of the entry to place.

node.description: The id of the node to place the entry below.

placement.description: The new placement's id, which the caller makes.

site.description: The id of the site the node belongs to.

slugs.description: The placement's slug in each locale it is to have. The kernel refuses a placement without a slug, or with a locale twice, with validation_failed.

locale.description: A language tag of a language, an optional script and an optional region, such as da, en-GB or sr-Latn-RS; the kernel writes the language in lowercase, the script in title case and the region in uppercase.

locale_slug.description: The slug of a placement in one locale.

slug.description: The last segment of the placement's path in the locale: 1 to 255 characters without a slash or white space, and not . or ..; compared exactly.
